newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Tuesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 1.049 billion yuan from 4.186 billion yuan with the 60-day contract the most actively traded.
Trading was dull, traders said, mainly because state banks and short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, traded less after heavy borrowing on Monday.
Borrowing from grain-producing provinces for purchasing grain from farmers on the approach of the summer harvest season would be the key factor for the market in the short term, they said.
The interbank rates were likely to rise slightly with turnover picking up in the next few days, traders said.
